hint_ladder.title: Connect to 'Litigation'
hint_ladder.text: Ang 'litigation' ay lawsuit sa korte. So 'litigious' means someone na mahilig mag-demanda, yung tipong bawat away, gusto niyang umabot sa korte.

hint_ladder.title: Suffix -ous = 'full of'
hint_ladder.text: Suffix -ous ay nangangahulugang 'puno ng' o 'madalas.' Litigious = puno ng lawsuit, laging naghahabol ng kaso. Ito ay adjective.

hint_ladder.title: I-eliminate ang mga distractor
hint_ladder.text: A (peaceful) ay kabaligtaran. B (settlement-prone) ay gusto ng ayos, hindi demanda. D (arbitration) ay noun, process. Tanging C (tending to sue) an...

hint_ladder.title: Isipin ang Kapitbahay
hint_ladder.text: Kung may kapitbahay kang lahat ng maliit na bagay, reklamo agad sa barangay para mag-file ng kaso, siya ay litigious. Ganun lang kadali 'yun!

A.text: You might have chosen A because 'peaceful' seems positive but it's the opposite of lawsuit-happy litigious.

B.text: You might have chosen B because settlement-prone seems court-related, but it means avoiding lawsuits, not starting them.

C.text: Correct. 'Litigious' means having a tendency to sue or engage in lawsuits.

D.text: You might have chosen D because arbitration is a legal term, but it's a noun for out-of-court resolution, not an adjective for suing.

deconstruct_text:
Isipin mo nasa barangay hall, may kapitbahay na lahat na lang pinapa-barangay at gusto pang umabot sa korte. That's litigious — mapapel sa demanda, laging handang magsampa ng kaso. Ang root word ay 'litigation', ibig sabihin lawsuit.

Taglish mnemonic: Tandaan: LITI- parang 'litigasyon' sa barangay; -GIOUS parang 'dyosis' pero 'dyos-' ay hindi, basta -ous ay 'full of.' So litigious = full of lawsuits. Now check options: A. Peaceful — kabaligtaran. B. Settlement-prone — gusto pa ng ayos, hindi dema...

**Watch-Out Zone: synonym_antonym_inversion** — 'Peaceful' is opposite of litigation-ha...
next_time_rule: Think: 'Litigious' = full of lawsuits. Link it to 'litigation' (lawsuit). If the word ends in -ous and is about law, it means prone to that action.
